Classify participants and vitals for the Repeat Measurements report

Source: R/rm_Classify.R
rm_Classify.Rd

`r lifecycle::badge("experimental")`

Windows every vital of every enrolled participant once, with the same logic as the `kri0020` / `cou0020` metrics, so every section of the report reads one frame. Summing `Numerator` and `Denominator` by site or country reproduces the metrics.

A participant's flag for a vital uses one of two rules: * `"count"` (default): repeating windows `Numerator` against `vFlagThresholds` (default Amber at 2, Red at 3 or more). * `"rate"`: `Numerator / Denominator` against `vFlagThresholds` (default the `kri0020` `Threshold` in `dfMetrics`, else 20% / 30%).

Amber is at or above the first threshold, Red at or above the second. Participants with fewer than `nMinWindows` windows are `Not evaluable`. Height, BSA and any other numeric `Mapped_VS` column are windowed and flagged the same way, although they have no KRI. With `sysbp` and `diabp`, paired blood pressure (`bp`, see [rm_Vitals()]) is added.

Usage

rm_Classify(
  lListings,
  dfMetrics = NULL,
  nWindowLength = NULL,
  strFlagRule = c("count", "rate"),
  vFlagThresholds = NULL,
  nMinWindows = 1
)

Arguments

lListings

`list` with `Mapped_SUBJ` (enrolled participants with `subjid`, `invid` and `country`; a missing `invid` or `country` is shown as `"(missing)"`) and `Mapped_VS`.

dfMetrics

`data.frame` Reporting metrics; the `kri0020*` rows supply the window length and the rate thresholds. Optional.

nWindowLength

`numeric` Window length when `dfMetrics` has none. Default `NULL`, meaning 3. When `dfMetrics` has a window length, it wins and a different `nWindowLength` raises a warning.

strFlagRule

`character` `"count"` or `"rate"`.

vFlagThresholds

`numeric` Amber and Red thresholds: repeating windows for `"count"`, a proportion of windows for `"rate"`. Default `NULL`: see Details.

nMinWindows

`numeric` Windows a participant needs for a flag. Default 1.

Value

A `list`: * `participants`: one row per participant and vital with `studyid`, `country`, `invid`, `subjid`, `vital`, `metric`, `n_records` (non-missing measurements), `Numerator`, `Denominator`, `rate` and `flag` (a factor with the levels of [rm_FlagColors()]). * `measurements`: one row per non-missing measurement with `studyid`, `country`, `invid`, `subjid`, `record`, `visit`, `vs_dt`, `vital`, `value` (`NA` for paired BP), `value_text` (the displayed value), `seq`, `in_repeat_window` and `window_start` (see [Mark_ConsecutiveRepeats()]). * `records`: the enrolled participants' `Mapped_VS` rows, with `country` and `invid` from `Mapped_SUBJ` and a `record` key that `measurements` refers to. * `vitals`: the rows of [rm_Vitals()] in the report, plus any other numeric `Mapped_VS` column. * `meta`: `window_length`, `window_source` (`"metrics"`, `"argument"` or `"default"`), `rule`, `thresholds` (Amber, Red), `min_windows` and `split_sites` (sites whose participants have more than one country; a warning lists them).
